name: multi-store-order-notification-app
description: Multi-Store Order Notification System with Separated Ports

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "SERVER,VENDOR,CUSTOMER,STUDIO" -c "blue.bold,amber.bold,magenta.bold,green.bold" "npm start --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix vendor" "npm run dev --prefix customer" "npm run db:studio"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n "SERVER,VENDOR,CUSTOMER,STUDIO" -c "blue.bold,amber.bold,magenta.bold,green.bold" "npm start --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix vendor" "npm run dev --prefix customer" "npm run db:studio"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix vendor && npm install --prefix customer
scripts.db:setup: cd server && npx prisma db push && npm run db:seed
